description:
Upstream loads user keybinding overrides from `~/.claude/keybindings.json`. Our Keybindings module accepts user overrides in `new/1` but nothing reads the config file or passes overrides in.

Implement:
1. On TUI startup (in Interactive.do_run), read `~/.octo_pi/keybindings.json` if it exists.
2. Parse it and pass the overrides to `Keybindings.new/1`.
3. Thread the resulting `Keybindings` struct through Interactive state so `handle_event` can use `Keybindings.matches?/3` instead of hardcoded key patterns.

Ref: `coding-agent/src/core/keybindings.ts` L204-320 (KeybindingsManager class, config loading, legacy migration).
title: Keybindings: user config loading from ~/.octo_pi/keybindings.json
